patch_description: Crossover combining the strongest elements: the targeted geometric annealing from the high-scoring program (perturbing vertices of the currently-smallest triangles along the outward normal to the opposite edge, with a smooth mean-of-smallest-K objective), its strict greedy polish phase, multiple structured initializations (rings, 3-fold symmetric triangle config, perturbed grid), reheat cycles, and final hull-area normalization to a unit-area convex region. This dominates the naive unit-square clipped annealing of the current program (score 0.18) and reproduces the 0.76 approach with modest iteration increases for added robustness.
